title: A worker adding a closed-field gate plants a failure in each part of a field that can carry free text (a url's host, path, query and fragment)
goal: The worker rules (bl_dispatch.WORKER_RULES) say that an item adding a gate that keeps free text out of a stored field plants one failure per part of the field that can carry text (for a url: host, path, query and fragment), not one per field; a brief of an item whose goal names a closed-field gate prints that rule; a test of brief ID on such an item asserts the line.

run:
import sys,tempfile,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import bl_base,bl_dispatch
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git','init','-q',d],check=True)
bl=bl_base.Backlog(d)
def brief(goal):
    bl.items['ST-bbbbbbbb']=dict(id='ST-bbbbbbbb',kind='story',title='Stored url gate',status='todo',goal=goal,touches=['_tools/x.py'],checks=[dict(run=['true'])])
    return bl_dispatch.compose_brief(bl,'ST-bbbbbbbb')
def rule(t):
    return [l for l in t.splitlines() if 'fragment' in l.lower() and 'query' in l.lower()]
gate=rule(brief('Adds a gate that keeps free text out of the stored url field of a source row.'))
other=rule(brief('Renames a flag of the read subcommand.'))
sys.exit(0 if gate and not other else 1)
